content:
dev-bot: Alert — elevated 502/504 error rate for hosted inference in eu-west2-az3. Error rate ~18% above baseline, started ~2025-06-14T09:12Z. Sample traces: trc-9982, trc-9983. Affected tenants include AcmeHealth and FlowDesk. @mike_oncall please triage.

mike_oncall: I'm on it. Confirming gateway 502 spikes and backend timeouts. Looking at egress metrics: retransmits increased from 1.2% to ~8% between az3 edge -> transit peer.

ashley_neteng: Looking at BGP adjacencies now — saw intermittent flaps to ASN 64512 around 09:10Z, ECMP weight imbalance possible. Pulling pcap from the affected edge and asking provider for drop/CRC stats.

jia_support: AcmeHealth on support call — they see most calls fail 502 on first attempt, some 401s on retries. They are concerned about retries incurring extra cost and token churn.

eli_infra: Quick mitigation: enabling cross-AZ fallback on the routing layer for heavy tenants (prefer az1/az2 for new sessions). Starting rollout to reduce surface area while we investigate.

mike_oncall: Can someone confirm whether 401s are auth-regressed or a side effect of gateway retries contacting auth-svc? @jia_support please paste a sample trace and request headers (redact tokens).

jia_support: Pasting condensed trace for trc-9982: initial attempt -> 401 from auth-svc after 3s, client retries -> gateway forwards -> upstream times out -> 502 returned. Header excerpt: Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_TOKEN>.

mike_oncall: Log snippet from gateway around trc-9982:
```
2025-06-14T09:12:05Z gateway[gw-eu-west2-az3]: req=trc-9982 route=/v1/generate upstream=auth-svc latency=3.2s err=upstream timeout
2025-06-14T09:12:08Z gateway[gw-eu-west2-az3]: req=trc-9982 route=/v1/generate upstream=model-srv latency=15.1s err=upstream timeout
```

ashley_neteng: PCAP summary shows a burst of duplicate ACKs and retransmits on the peer-facing interface. Provider reports interface CRC errors and is opening a maintenance ticket; they propose temporary reroute. Uploaded pcap to triage bucket.

eli_infra: Mitigation actions taken: 1) Lowered priority for the transit provider in smart-routing at 09:22Z. 2) Enabled cross-AZ fallback for new flows at 09:25Z. 3) Increase auth-svc connection pool limits for az3 to mitigate token validation timeouts.

tom_cust_success: Notified AcmeHealth of our mitigation steps and ETA. They're asking about SLA credits and whether we can failover their traffic immediately to eu-west1.

mike_oncall: For failover to eu-west1 we need to ensure model pinning and data residency allowances. @eli_infra can we create a tenant-scoped routing override for AcmeHealth as a short-term action?

eli_infra: Yes, can push a tenant override to route AcmeHealth to eu-west1-az2 in ~5 minutes. Will require a cache warmup; expect ~30s higher latency initially.

jia_support: Repro steps from AcmeHealth (they say reliable repro):
1) 5 concurrent clients doing POST /v1/generate (stream=false)
2) payload size ~4k tokens, timeout client-side 25s
3) after ~15-20s many requests return 502 or hang until client retries
Curl example they used:
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-xxx","input":"<long prompt>"}' --max-time 25
```

ashley_neteng: PCAP id: pcap-eu2-09312.tar.gz uploaded to s3://redwood-triage/pcaps/pcap-eu2-09312.tar.gz. Provider ticket ID: tp-4321. Asking for interim BGP reroute and interface diagnostics.

mike_oncall: Next steps: (1) leave smart-routing change in place, monitor error-rate for 15m; (2) enable tenant override for AcmeHealth if they request failover; (3) collect full tcpdump/traceroute for any new traces and attach to provider ticket; (4) follow up with billing on potential credits. Update in 10m.

dev-bot: Metrics update @09:35Z — error-rate decreased to ~6% in eu-west2-az3 after smart-routing adjustment. Continuing to monitor. :thumbsup:

mike_oncall: Good improvement. Keep provider ticket open until CRCs are cleared and BGP flaps stop. If error-rate creeps above 5% again we will perform tenant failovers.

tom_cust_success: I'll keep AcmeHealth updated and collect formal repro logs for billing review.

jia_support: Will consolidate customer traces (trc-9982, trc-9983, trc-9991) and attach to incident doc after this thread.

ashley_neteng: Provider just confirmed they scheduled a reroute at 09:40Z. Will post follow-up when CRC stats normalize.

mike_oncall: Thanks team. Closing loop in 30m or when provider confirms fix.
